form.title: Join The Circle · Sales School
form.subtitle: Fill in your details to apply
form._submitFormat_note: json (default) | formspree | form-urlencoded | google-apps-script (no-cors: the response cannot be read, so any completed request counts as success). See docs/FORM_BACKEND_SETUP.md.
form._minSubmitSeconds_note: Submissions faster than this many seconds after the form opens are treated as bots (silently shown as success, nothing sent).
form._submitEndpoint_note: Leave empty for demo mode (nothing is sent, no data stored). Set to a URL (Formspree, Google Apps Script, your API) to POST the form as JSON.

booking.title: Let's Schedule Your Call
booking.subtitle: Pick a time that works for you
booking._prefill_note: false (default, privacy): Calendly asks for name/email itself. true: name and email from the application form are passed to Calendly in the embed URL.

analytics._note: provider: none | ga4 (set id G-XXXXXXX) | plausible (set domain) | custom (set endpoint, https). respectDnt: honour Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control. requireConsent: hold all tracking until setAnalyticsConsent(true) is called. See docs/ANALYTICS.md.
